esp32.detail: 5 pins wired; MiCS-6814 CO / NO2 / NH3 three-channel gas sensor breakout needs at least 4.9 V, so it is powered from 5 V. U2.CO → D32 (GPIO32) — an analog-capable pin. U2.NH3 → D33 (GPIO33) — an analog-capable pin. U2.NO2 → D34 (GPIO34) — an analog-capable pin. Added a 100 kΩ resistor from CO to 3V3, as the datasheet's circuit requires. Added a 100 kΩ resistor from NH3 to 3V3, as the datasheet's circuit requires. Added a 10 kΩ resistor from NO2 to 3V3, as the datasheet's circuit requires. Added the mics6814.py driver written from the datasheet.
Reports each channel's sensing resistance from the datasheet load-resistor divider: passes
